name: Password Recovery Completion Rejected
summary: An anonymous user successfully verifies the six-digit recovery code and reaches the new-password state, but the submitted password replacement is rejected, so the password remains unchanged and the user stays on the new-password view.
finalOutcome: The recovery code was accepted and reset authority exists, but the password replacement was not applied. The user remains on Choose a New Password with a neutral validation or reset failure and may correct the password and retry.

sourceReferences.note: FailedReset_Should_ReturnFailure_WithoutRecordingCompletion proves that password replacement can fail after recovery authority has already been established.

Completion rejection is a distinct canonical behavior because it occurs after successful code verification, ends on the new-password view, and permits different next actions than recovery-code rejection.
